build_image_mae_model: build a MaskedAutoEncoder for image pretraining using image_mae with custom encoder and decoder hyperparameters
build_audio_mae_model: build a MaskedAutoEncoder for audio pretraining using audio_mae with a SwinTransformer decoder
create_vit_l_16_image_mae: create a large ViT-based image MAE model with 24 encoder layers using vit_l_16_image_mae
create_vit_b_16_audio_mae: create a base ViT-based audio MAE model with 12 encoder layers using vit_b_16_audio_mae
run_masked_autoencoder_forward: run a forward pass through a MaskedAutoEncoder to get encoder output and decoder predictions
